stairway.principle: every training block climbs like a stairway: small steps to the halfway week, slightly bigger after it, the hardest weeks last; one rule for every person
stairway.phases_by_N_note: labels only (ACCLIMATION / DRIVE / HARDEST); 12 and 8 equal generator_spec plan_types phases_by_level

placed.note: a muscle rises at most max(1 set, 7 %) a week (whole sets, helpers may add 0.5); the week total at most 7 %; 10 % is never reached

checkin.effort_10_meaning: the max I could do, and I made it (successful, 0 RIR)
checkin.couldnt_do_it: one level down or assisted next week, sets unchanged

track.note: placed sets follow the planned T(w): never more than 1 set above in week 1, never 1 or more behind (unless a schedule warning names the muscle); the week total never stays flat two weeks in a row; no "hold" without a check-in

capacity.note: the whole stairway must fit the chosen minutes: the peak week is placed first; muscles whose peak does not fit start lower (never below the floor) so every week can still climb (D-67)

group_day_reduction.note: a group whose 2 x 2 minimum on every day is above its week-1 target is trained on fewer days, each with 2 exercises

full_body_days.rule: every muscle group trained that day gets 2-4 exercises, never 1

exercises_per_group.exempt_note: conjugate four-role days stay as written (flagged, master 10.3)

long_day.note: full-body days may run a little longer (warning, not an error)

cut_order.status: PROPOSED (v1.2 review: Olympic sets above the budget, 1-set fillers and duplicate isolations go before any target muscle)

bilateral_share.sport_share_note: 'sport' = SportDef.share (from 04 v1.1 profiles[].bilateral_unilateral; block_start -> block_end over the exercise blocks; PRE / IN from pre_season / in_season)

equipment.crossfit_box_note: a CrossFit box = HOME_BARBELL + extras (bumpers, KBs, medballs, boxes, rings, rower / bike / ski erg); no separate profile in Phase 0 (D-16)
